title: CLAUDE.md
text: Applies every surface prose lands front reader: vignettes (.qmd), README, roxygen @description / @details, code comments, commit messages, PR titles descriptions. Hard rules: em-dashes, neither ASCII Unicode variant. Reads AI-generated. Use commas, colons, semicolons, full stops. British English. normalise, randomised, centred, favour, analyse, colour. corporate filler: “leverages”, “utilises”, “seamlessly”, “cutting-edge”, “robust”, “state---art”, “empowers”, “enables”, “unlocks”, “delve ”. hedge stacks (“may sometimes potentially”), filler transitions (“Furthermore”, “Moreover”, “worth noting ”), throat-clearing intros (“section walk ”). trailing paragraphs recap section just showed. exception conclusion adds something forward-looking (roadmap, caveats, try next). Positive patterns: Short sentences. Active voice. Contractions fine usually better. Concrete abstract, numbers possible. “25k points across 25 clusters 32D” beats “moderately sized clustered dataset”. Admit weaknesses directly. “Apple Silicon GPU rarely blows CPU water” beats hedging around . Brief, specific editorialising welcome (“gets painful fast”, “watch space”). twice per vignette, per section. Keep @param / @returns roxygen bullets terse structured. style rules prose blocks. Older files may still contain em-dashes rule. go retroactive rewriting spree, fix touch surrounding prose anyway.
